ui.chat.tag_groups.collapse.role: disclosure button label, group currently open
ui.chat.tag_groups.collapse.note: Accessible name and tooltip of the chevron button at the start of a 28px tag group subheader in the conversation sidebar (220px+ wide). The button folds or unfolds that tag's conversations; the header keeps showing the tag name and its count either way. {name} is a user-authored tag name (or the localized word for Untagged) and may be long; keep it intact and unquoted unless the locale requires quotation for an embedded name. Use the same verb pair the app already uses for collapse/expand controls.
